lines.en: label harukachristmalloween1:
scene harukachikabr1
: Mngh?!
lines.zh: : Mngh?!

lines.en: But she collided with something upon reaching her destination.
lines.zh: 可她到达目的地时，撞上了什么东西。

lines.en: And even though there was a cloud of all-consuming misery swirling around her, it could not prevent the overwhelming Japanese instinct to immediately break character and apologize.
lines.zh: 尽管她周围盘旋着一团吞噬一切的不幸，这也没能压过那种压倒性的、日本人特有的本能——立刻脱离角色、开口道歉。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr2
: I’m sorry! I didn’t-
lines.zh: : 对不起！我不是故意——

lines.en: scene harukachikabr3
: Wait, Chika? Is that you?
lines.zh: : 等等，Chika？是你吗？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr4
: No! Sorry! Wrong person! Nothing to see here! Just a selfish fucking {i}idiot!{/i}
lines.zh: : 不是！抱歉！认错人了！没什么好看的！只是个自私的该死{i}「蠢货」{/i}！

lines.en: : Are you crying? What happened?
lines.zh: : 你在哭吗？发生了什么事？

lines.en: : {i}Nothing! Can I just...get a few minutes please?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}「什么都没有！能不能就……让我一个人待几分钟？！」{/i}

lines.en: scene harukachikabr5
: I feel like it would be very irresponsible of me to just leave you like this. Do you want to talk about it?
lines.zh: : 我觉得就这么把你丢下，实在太不负责任了。你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : Talking is what got me into this mess in the first place! So chances are if I do it again now, you’ll just throw some {i}other{/i} horrible reveal at me in the end and remind me of how selfish I’ve become!
lines.zh: : 就是说话才让我沦落到这步田地的！所以如果我现在再说一遍，你大概到最后也会甩给我{i}「另一个」{/i}可怕的真相，再提醒我我变得有多自私！

lines.en: : Or I could...promise to {i}not{/i} do that?
lines.zh: : 那我也可以……保证{i}「不」{/i}那么做？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr6
: Then I look selfish for not caring! I can’t fucking win! You just...tell me all {i}your{/i} problems or something! I’m fine!
lines.zh: : 那样又显得我不在乎，太自私了！我他妈怎么都赢不了！你就……说说{i}「你」{/i}的烦恼什么的吧！我没事！

lines.en: : You are most certainly not fine. And I really think you should try to quiet down unless you want even {i}more{/i} people to overhear this and come swooping in to add to your discomfort.
lines.zh: : 你绝对不是没事。而且我真的觉得你该小声点，除非你想让「{i}更{/i}多」人听见，然后蜂拥过来给你添堵。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr7
: Why am I like this now? What {i}happened?{/i} I used to be dependable. I had everything together. And now I just...what? Now I {i}don’t?{/i} Why?! Where’d all of that go?!
lines.zh: : 我为什么会变成现在这样？到底{i}「发生了什么」{/i}？我以前很靠谱的。我把一切都打理得井井有条。可现在我就……什么？现在就{i}「不行了」{/i}？为什么？！那些都跑到哪儿去了？！

lines.en: : I don’t know you well enough to answer that, Chika...
lines.zh: : 我跟你还不算熟，答不上来，Chika……

lines.en: scene harukachikabr8
: But I {i}do{/i} know that Rin would kill me if I didn’t at least {i}try{/i} to help you right now.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}「确实」{/i}知道，如果我现在不至少{i}「试着」{/i}帮你一把，Rin 会杀了我的。

lines.en: : So why don’t you just go on and do whatever it is you came in here to do just...with {i}me{/i} there as well? For moral support.
lines.zh: : 所以你不如就继续做你进这儿来要做的事吧，只是……让「{i}我{/i}」也一起。给你当个精神支柱。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr9
: Though...it did just dawn on me where we are. So if you {i}didn’t{/i} come in here to cry like I assumed and actually just-
lines.zh: : 不过……我刚反应过来我们现在在哪儿。所以如果你{i}「不是」{/i}像我想的那样进来哭，而是真的只是——

lines.en: : I’m obviously here to cry. Look at me. And look {i}hard{/i} since this is what you’re going to need to put up with if you don’t take my advice and just leave right now.
lines.zh: : 我显然是来哭的。看看我。而且{i}「仔细」{/i}看，因为如果你不听我的劝、现在就走，以后就得一直忍受这个了。

lines.en: : I can see you. And I’m pretty sure I can put up with it if you {i}do{/i} want to talk.
lines.zh: : 我看得见你。而且我敢肯定，如果你{i}真的{/i}想聊，我是受得住的。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr10
: No. I don’t want to drag Rin’s {i}boss{/i} into this too. I’ve made things hard enough on her already.
lines.zh: : 不。我不想把 Rin 的{i}「老板」{/i}也拖进来。我已经给她添够麻烦了。

lines.en: : If this is about your, uhh...{i}encounter{/i} together, I’m already in the loop.
lines.zh: : 如果这事跟你们的那次，呃……{i}「遭遇」{/i}有关，我已经知道了。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr11
: You...
: Wait. You {i}know?{/i} She told you?
lines.zh: : 等等。你「{i}知道{/i}」？她告诉你的？

lines.en: : You’re not the only one struggling with stuff, you know. Rin vents to me all the-
lines.zh: : 有烦恼的人不止你一个，你知道吗。Rin 什么都跟我说——

lines.en: scene harukachikabr12
: In there. Now.
lines.zh: : 进去。现在。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr13
: God, I can’t believe she told her {i}boss! It took everything I had to tell Uta and {i}she’s{/i} only my supervisor!
lines.zh: : 天哪，我简直不敢相信她居然告诉了她{i}「老板」{/i}！我连跟 Uta 说都费了九牛二虎之力，而她{i}「只是」{/i}我的上司！

lines.en: : To be fair, I’m just as much of her work-mom as I am her boss. She tells me everything whether I like it or not.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我对她来说既是老板，也算工作上的妈妈。不管我愿不愿意，她什么都跟我说。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr14
: But thankfully, I {i}do{/i} like it. I kind of feed off of teen gossip. It keeps me feeling relevant, so this is actually kind of great for me.
lines.zh: : 不过谢天谢地，我{i}「确实」{/i}乐意听。我有点靠青少年的八卦过活。这让我觉得自己还没过时，所以对我来说其实挺好的。

lines.en: : That was the first time I’ve ever done anything with a girl...I don’t even know if I did it right.
lines.zh: : 那是我这辈子第一次跟女生做那种事……我甚至不知道自己做对了没有。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr15
: I think it matters less if you did it {i}correctly{/i} and more that you just did it in the first place. That must have been a big decision for you with how into Sensei you are, right?
lines.zh: : 我觉得，你做得{i}「正不正确」{/i}没那么重要，重要的是你{i}「做了」{/i}。考虑到你有多喜欢 Sensei，这对你来说一定是个很大的决定，对吧？

lines.en: : In hindsight, yeah. But in the moment, I...I just {i}wanted{/i} to. It felt right.
lines.zh: : 事后想想，是的。但在当时，我……我就是{i}「想」{/i}做。感觉是对的。

lines.en: : That’s not why I’m crying, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不是为这个哭的。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr16
: Wait, it’s not? Then what-
lines.zh: : 等等，不是？那是什么——

lines.en: : I mean, it {i}kind{/i} of is. It’s...related to it at least. It’s just...this whole thing has distracted me from what’s {i}really{/i} important and now I’m hurting {i}other{/i} people too.
lines.zh: : 我是说，也{i}「算」{/i}是吧。至少跟它有关。只是……这整件事让我分了心，忘了什么才是{i}「真正」{/i}重要的，结果现在连{i}「别人」{/i}也被我伤害了。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr17
: God, everything would be so much easier if I was just asexual! Or even {i}heterosexual{/i} because then all I’d have to fucking deal with is jealousy and {i}that’s{/i} way easier than this!
lines.zh: : 天哪，要是我无性恋就好了，一切都会简单得多！哪怕是{i}「异性恋」{/i}也行，那样我他妈要对付的就只有嫉妒，{i}「那」{/i}可比现在容易多了！

lines.en: : Chika...I understand where you’re coming from. I’ve also hurt people from being too focused on myself.
lines.zh: : Chika……我懂你的感受。我也因为太专注于自己而伤害过别人。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr18
: You know Makoto’s mom? Well, she’s a really good friend of mine. And I wasn’t there for her when her husband died because I was too absorbed in {i}my{/i} situation.
lines.zh: : 你认识 Makoto 的妈妈吧？嗯，她是我的一个好朋友。她丈夫去世的时候我没陪在她身边，因为我太陷在{i}自己{/i}的处境里了。

lines.en: : It happens with Sana’s mom too. She can be very unstable and I’m not always there for her when she needs me to be. Then, when I {i}am,{/i} I can’t really help at all.
lines.zh: : 对 Sana 的妈妈也是这样。她情绪很不稳定，她需要我的时候我并不总在。就算我{i}「在」{/i}了，也帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : So I {i}know{/i} what it’s like to be selfish. Every last bit of my existence is just selfishness at this point. There won’t be anything left to experience if you dwell on that forever, though.
lines.zh: : 所以我「{i}知道{/i}」自私是什么滋味。到了现在，我存在的每一寸都只剩下自私了。不过，如果你永远纠结于此，就什么也体验不到了。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr19
: So there’s no solution? You just...have to try not to dwell on it? I can’t get better?
lines.zh: : 所以没有解决办法？你只能……尽量不去纠结？我没法变好吗？

lines.en: : I’m not a good role model, so don’t take it from me — but I’m not sure you can ever really {i}recover{/i} from the parts of you that make you who you are.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么好榜样，所以别拿我的话当真理——不过我不确定，一个人真的能从构成他自身的那部分里{i}「康复」{/i}过来。

lines.en: : You’re not unwell or anything. There’s just some stuff you need to work on. And I think the fact that you’re this torn up over it makes you closer to redemption than {i}I’ve{/i} ever been.
lines.zh: : 你又没有病什么的。只是有些地方需要改进。而且我觉得，你能为这件事这么痛苦，说明你比{i}我{/i}任何时候都更接近救赎。

lines.en: : Really? Do you...not get upset when people get hurt because of {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 真的吗？别人因{i}「你」{/i}而受伤的时候，你不会难过吗？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr20
: I do. I love my friends and I don’t ever want them to hurt.
lines.zh: : 会。我爱我的朋友们，我从来不想让他们受伤。

lines.en: : I just fear I’m beyond helping. And that there are parts of me I can’t ever change no matter how badly I want to change them.
lines.zh: : 我只是害怕自己已经没救了。我身上有些部分，不管我多想改，都永远改不掉。

lines.en: : Heh...sounds familiar. Are {i}you{/i} sleeping with Sensei too then? Did you get that from him?
lines.zh: : 呵……听着真耳熟。「{i}你{/i}」也在跟 Sensei 上床吗？这是跟他学的？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr21
: You can just admit it, Haruka. He’s the least of my problems right now. And I’ve already come to accept that he’s been screwing everyone this whole time.
lines.zh: : 你直接承认就行了，Haruka。他现在是我最不操心的事了。而且我早就接受了他从头到尾都在跟所有人乱搞这个事实。

lines.en: : I am...
lines.zh: : 我是……

lines.en: : I didn’t get that from {i}him,{/i} though. I think I resigned myself to being a bad person the moment my husband left.
lines.zh: : 不过这不是跟「{i}他{/i}」学的。我想，从我丈夫离开的那一刻起，我就认命当一个坏人了。

lines.en: : Oh, right...you’re married too.
lines.zh: : 哦，对……你也结婚了。

lines.en: : That’s right. I have a husband. A husband I can’t see anymore. And I’ve been filling that void the only way I know how.
lines.zh: : 没错。我有丈夫。一个我再也见不到的丈夫。而我一直在用我唯一会的方式填补那个空洞。

lines.en: : Being lonely is terrifying. And Sensei makes me feel a little less alone sometimes. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 孤独很可怕。而 Sensei 有时让我觉得没那么孤单。就这么简单。

lines.en: : So yes, I bear the mark of a traitor now. And yes, it burns. But at least I’m not afraid. Not of being alone, at least.
lines.zh: : 所以没错，我现在身上带着叛徒的印记。没错，它在灼烧。但至少我不害怕。至少不怕孤独。

lines.en: : And frankly, I think I’d be in the same exact situation even if it wasn’t Sensei. I think I’d have taken any man willing to put me out of my misery.
lines.zh: : 而且坦白说，我觉得就算不是 Sensei，我也会落到一模一样的处境。我想，任何一个愿意让我摆脱这份痛苦的男人，我都会接受。

lines.en: : I just lucked out and wound up with one completely lacking morals. So much so that I forget I’m cheating at all sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是运气好，碰上了一个彻底没有道德底线的人。好到有时候我甚至忘了自己是在出轨。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr22
: That’s dark as fuck, Haruka. I don’t think I’d ever be able to cheat on someone I’m married to.
lines.zh: : 这也太丧了，Haruka。我觉得我永远做不到背叛自己的丈夫。

lines.en: : I didn’t either until I was alone. But hey, at least I never cheated on him when he was around. So a certain {i}somebody{/i} here has me beat in that department, at least.
lines.zh: : 在独自一人之前，我也觉得自己做不到。不过嘿，至少他在的时候我从没背叛过他。所以在这方面，这儿的{i}某「个人」{/i}至少比我还厉害。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr23
: Assuming he even {i}thinks{/i} we’re dating at all and wasn’t just going along with it to keep me from crying.
lines.zh: : 前提是他还{i}「觉得」{/i}我们在交往，而不是为了不让我哭才顺着我的。

lines.en: : Either way, it still hurts. And I still feel guilty about it. I just...I don’t know. I wasn’t thinking. But now thinking is {i}all{/i} I can do.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，还是很疼。我还是很内疚。我只是……我不知道。我当时没想那么多。可现在，除了想，我{i}什么都做不了{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s just lately...I’ve been thinking of Rin more. That {i}she’s{/i} the one I want to see the most. But I fucked up that chance years ago and now I have to watch as {i}she{/i} starts to fuck Sensei too.
lines.zh: : 就是最近……我越来越想到 Rin。我最想见的人是{i}「她」{/i}。可我几年前就把那个机会搞砸了，现在只能眼睁睁看着{i}「她」{/i}也开始跟 Sensei 上床。

lines.en: : Like...maybe {i}everyone’s{/i} just selfish if we’re all going to be at each other’s throats like this? Why does {i}our{/i} happiness always need to come at the cost of someone else’s?
lines.zh: : 就像……如果我们都要这么互相撕咬，那{i}「所有人」{/i}都很自私？为什么{i}「我们」{/i}的幸福总要以别人的幸福为代价？

lines.en: : Just blame it on the dating pool. You’re all pining after the same guy, after all. I imagine things would be way less...{i}competitive{/i} with other guys around.
lines.zh: : 怪就怪在这片择偶池吧。毕竟你们都在为同一个男人神魂颠倒。我想如果周围有别的选择，事情就不会这么……{i}「有竞争性」{/i}了。

lines.en: : I doubt it. Almost all of us are at least a {i}little{/i} bi. Which is why it’s so weird that more of us aren’t just dating each other to try and {i}avoid{/i} all of this pain.
lines.zh: : 我可不这么想。我们几乎所有人至少都{i}「有点」{/i}双性恋。所以奇怪的是，为什么没有更多人干脆彼此交往，好{i}「避开」{/i}所有这些痛苦。

lines.en: : Rin had the right idea from the start. And sometimes, I wish I accepted her confession back then. I probably wouldn’t be crying in a bathroom right now if I did, at least.
lines.zh: : Rin 从一开始就是对的。有时候我真希望自己当时接受了她的告白。至少那样的话，我现在就不会在洗手间里哭了。

lines.en: : You’re really serious about her then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那你对她是认真的了？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr24
: Haruka...can I ask what it is she said about me? When you guys talked about our...{i}thing.{/i} Or would that be, like...an invasion of privacy or whatever?
lines.zh: : Haruka……我能问问她说了什么吗？关于我们的那件{i}「事」{/i}。还是说，那算是……侵犯隐私什么的？

lines.en: : It was mostly just confusion, I think. Like, she {i}finally{/i} resigned herself to the fact that nothing would ever happen between you guys. And then, boom. {i}You’re{/i} the aggressor.
lines.zh: : 我记得，她主要只是困惑。就是，她{i}「终于」{/i}接受了你们之间永远不会有什么这个事实。然后，砰。{i}「你」{/i}成了主动的那一方。

lines.en: : No one in their right mind would know how to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 任何一个正常人都不知该怎么应对这种事。

lines.en: : But what if I {i}keep{/i} being the aggressor? If I do that, do you really think I have a shot? Be honest.
lines.zh: : 可如果我「{i}继续{/i}」主动呢？如果我这么做，你觉得我有机会吗？说实话。

lines.en: : Is that what you want?
lines.zh: : 这是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But if you have a definitive answer to that question, it sure as hell might help me figure it out. I just don’t want any more regrets.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不过如果你对这个问题有明确的答案，那绝对能帮我理清楚。我只是不想再有任何遗憾了。

lines.en: : Neither does Rin.
lines.zh: : Rin 也不想。

lines.en: : And that’s exactly why I told her to follow her heart and go after Sensei instead of you.
lines.zh: : 而正因如此，我才叫她跟着自己的心走，去追 Sensei，而不是追你。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr25
: You did {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}「做了什么」{/i}？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr26
: She’s had feelings for him all along. If she keeps {i}denying{/i} those feelings in pursuit of choices she’s made before, all of which led to nothing, who’s to say anything will change?
lines.zh: : 她一直都喜欢他。如果她为了追求自己从前做过的、全都毫无结果的那些选择，而一直{i}「否认」{/i}这份感情，谁能保证事情会有改变？

lines.en: : At least this way, she gets to try something new. And pursue a future that might make her happy with a man she’s already comfortable with.
lines.zh: : 至少这样，她能尝试一些新东西。去追求一个可能让她幸福的未来，而且对方是个她已经相处得很自在的男人。

lines.en: : An adult man. Who you, another adult, told her to pursue over a girl her own age who is exponentially better for her and won’t cheat on her every opportunity she gets?
lines.zh: : 一个成年男人。而你，另一个成年人，叫她去追一个成年男人，而不是一个跟她同龄、对她好上无数倍、也不会一有机会就出轨的女孩？

lines.en: : So {i}now{/i} age matters to you? Are {i}you{/i} the only teenager Sensei can morally elect to sleep with? Isn’t that hypocritical, Chika?
lines.zh: : 所以{i}「现在」{/i}年龄对你来说重要了？{i}「你」{/i}是 Sensei 唯一在道德上可以选择睡的青少年吗？这不虚伪吗，Chika？

lines.en: : That’s not what I said! I just don’t get how you can call yourself her “work-mom” and then be like, “Oh, yeah! Let’s fuck the same guy! Who {i}cares{/i} if you’re still in high school?!”
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思！我只是不懂，你怎么能一边自称她的「工作妈妈」，一边说「哦，是吗！那我们就睡同一个男人吧！谁{i}「在乎」{/i}你还在上高中？！」

lines.en: : Did Sensei get this same talk? Do you even {i}care{/i} about age in this regard? Or are you just upset with me for not guiding Rin directly to you and it’s just easier to call me irresponsible?
lines.zh: : Sensei 也被你这么说过吗？你在这方面到底在不{i}在乎{/i}年龄？还是说你只是在生我的气，怪我没把 Rin 直接引向你，而骂我不负责任说起来更顺口？

lines.en: : I’m upset with everything! I just figured that the majority of adults would probably side with {i}me{/i} here given the implications of this!
lines.zh: : 我对一切都生气！我只是以为，考虑到这其中的意味，大多数成年人大概会站在{i}「我」{/i}这边！

lines.en: : And what are the implications, exactly? That {i}I’m{/i} a predator too?
lines.zh: : 那具体是什么意味？是说「{i}我{/i}」也是个捕食者？

lines.en: : Well...no. That’s not what I said. But you’re, at the very least, pushing an innocent girl down an extremely immoral path that could seriously hurt her...and you’re showing no remorse at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是。我不是那个意思。但至少，你在把一个无辜的女孩推上一条极其不道德、可能严重伤害她的路……而且你毫无悔意。

lines.en: : It’s like I said — I’ve already resigned myself to being a bad person. And, if we’re being honest here, I don’t see any issue with what Sensei does to you or anyone else so long as it’s consensual.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的——我早就认命当个坏人了。而且，老实说，只要双方自愿，我不觉得 Sensei 对你或任何人做的事有什么问题。

lines.en: : In fact, I’d do the same thing if the opportunity presented itself.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果有机会，我也会做同样的事。

lines.en: : You...what? Hold on-
lines.zh: : 你……什么？等等——

lines.en: : What I’m saying is — if {i}you{/i} need someone to cheer you up right now, the same way you cheered up Rin, I’d do it with no questions asked.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是——如果{i}「你」{/i}现在需要有人让你开心起来，就像你让 Rin 开心起来那样，我会二话不说地做。

lines.en: : And I’d {i}enjoy{/i} it too. Because that’s the kind of girl I am.
lines.zh: : 而且我也{i}「乐在其中」{/i}。因为我就是这种女人。

lines.en: : But the difference between {i}us{/i} is that {i}I{/i} have experience. And you wouldn’t leave this place wondering just what I am to you or where things go from here.
lines.zh: : 可{i}「我们」{/i}的不同之处在于，{i}「我」{/i}有经验。你走出这里时，不会纠结我对你来说算什么，也不知道接下来会怎样。

lines.en: : You can use me, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你可以利用我，Chika。

lines.en: : That’s all I’m really good for the way I am now anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正以我现在这个样子，我唯一擅长的就是这个了。

scene harukachikabr28
: Okay, bye.
lines.zh: : 好，再见。

lines.en: scene harukachikabr29
: Wait! Hold on! That...okay! So, that sounded probably...way worse than I wanted it to! I just...I thought that-
lines.zh: : 等等！等等！那……好吧！所以，那听起来大概……比我想要的糟糕多了！我只是……我以为——

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me, Haruka?...
lines.zh: : 你在跟我开玩笑吗，Haruka？……

lines.en: : You corner me in a bathroom while I’m vulnerable, pretend you actually give a shit, and then you try to {i}fuck{/i} me? Are you seriously that pathetic?
lines.zh: : 你趁我脆弱的时候把我堵在洗手间里，装作真的很在乎我，然后就想{i}「操」{/i}我？你真有这么可悲吗？

lines.en: scene harukachikabr30
: {i}Yes!{/i} I {i}am{/i} this pathetic! And {i}I{/i} came here to cry too specifically because I felt {i}bad{/i} about that!
lines.zh: : {i}「是！」{/i}我就是{i}「这么」{/i}可悲！而且{i}「我」{/i}也是来这儿哭的，就是因为我对这件事感到{i}「内疚」{/i}！

lines.en: : So bad that you try to fuck the first teenager you see? You expect me to believe that? Give me a fucking break. You just don’t want me to tell Rin.
lines.zh: : 内疚到你去操你见到的第一个青少年？你指望我信？省省吧。你只是不想让我告诉 Rin。

lines.en: : That doesn’t mean I don’t feel bad too! It’s just...why is it okay for {i}him{/i} to do it but not me?! He’s not the only one attracted to all of you! {i}I{/i} am too!
lines.zh: : 那不代表我就不内疚！只是……为什么{i}「他」{/i}做就可以，我就不行？！被你们所有人吸引的不止他一个！{i}「我」{/i}也是！

lines.en: : If anything, you could actually try and say I’m {i}increasing{/i} the dating pool right now! Fewer people get hurt if some of them come to me, right?!
lines.zh: : 倒不如说，你现在其实可以说我是在{i}「扩大」{/i}择偶池！如果有人来找我，受伤的人就少了，对吧？！

lines.en: scene harukachikabr31
: You have {i}no{/i} fucking shame, do you?
lines.zh: : 你他妈{i}一点羞耻心都没有{/i}吗？

lines.en: : {i}All{/i} I have is shame! But there could be so much more to give if I just...if someone loves me! I just need someone to love me! That’s it! So...please don’t tell anyone! Please!
lines.zh: : 我{i}「满脑子」{/i}都是羞耻！可如果有人爱我，我还能给出更多！我只是需要有人爱我！就这样！所以……求你别告诉任何人！求你了！

lines.en: : Un-fucking-real.
lines.zh: : 真是他妈的活久见。

lines.en: : But hey, thanks for showing me I’m not the worst person at the party after all. Weirdly enough, I actually feel a little better now.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，谢了，你让我知道我果然不是派对上最糟糕的人。奇怪的是，我现在居然感觉好一点了。

lines.en: : {i}Please...{/i}don’t tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 「{i}求你了……{/i}」别告诉任何人。

lines.en: : Just shut up already. You’re embarrassing yourself.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴吧你。你在丢自己的脸。

lines.en: scene black
: Chika, wait!
lines.zh: : Chika，等等！

lines.en: : Touch me again and I will {i}fucking{/i} kill you! Do you understand?!
lines.zh: : 再碰我一下，我{i}「他妈的」{/i}杀了你！听懂了吗？！

lines.en: : I’m {i}sorry!{/i} I wasn’t trying to make things weird! That just...it works for {i}him!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}「对不起！」{/i}我不是故意把气氛搞怪的！只是……那招对{i}「他」{/i}很管用！

lines.en: : GO. AWAY. NOW.
lines.zh: : 滚。现。在。

lines.en: : Fine! Fine...
: I’ll just...um...
: I’ll...yeah! Okay! I have an idea...
lines.zh: : 我就……对！好吧！我有个主意……
